pairs.target: dìèrrì , wéi lǎoshī bǎ chónghuà de yàng zhǐ jiāogěi tǎ wéi , jiào tā wènwèn tuīchē de lǎorén , zhèyàng xiě , chāo dān shíhuì buhuì lòu .
pairs.english: The following day, Teacher Vey handed Tavi the redrawn sample sheet and told him to ask the old cart-pusher whether wording it this way might get overlooked when slips were copied.
pairs.hanzi: 第二日，维老师把重画的样纸交给塔维，叫他问问推车的老人，这样写，抄单时会不会漏。

pairs.target: zhè búshì huàn hǎo de lù tú , tōng bùliǎo chē de zì nuó dào le duànxiàn páng , yuánlái de zǒulù fùběn réng liúzài huò háng , biéde dìfāng méiyǒu tiān .
pairs.english: This was not a replacement route map; the words no carts could cross had moved beside the broken line, the original walking copy still remained at the freight firm, and nothing was added elsewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 这不是换好的路图，通不了车的字挪到了断线旁，原来的走路副本仍留在货行，别的地方没有添。

pairs.target: yīwén yào qù fùjìn dì yìfēngxìn , jiàn tā jiāng zhǐ sāijìn cèzi , biàn shuō yìqǐ zǒu , huílái ruò rào shí pù , xiān wèn yǒuméiyǒu búyòng děng de .
pairs.english: Iven was going nearby to deliver a letter; seeing him tuck the paper into his notebook, he suggested going together, and if they called at a food shop on the way back, first asking whether anything needed no wait.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文要去附近递一封信，见他将纸塞进册子，便说一起走，回来若绕食铺，先问有没有不用等的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ zhǐ wèn jǐjùhuà , yīwén shuō zhèhuà zuìhǎo bié ràng zhèngzài zuòfàn de rén tīngjiàn , tāmen zuì huì bǎ jǐjùhuà biànchéng yídùnfàn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he himself would only ask a few questions; Iven said it was best not to let people cooking hear that, since they were experts at turning a few words into a whole meal.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己只问几句话，伊文说这话最好别让正在做饭的人听见，他们最会把几句话变成一顿饭。

pairs.target: wǔhòu de xiàngzi gāng sǎ guò shuǐ , huò háng hòumén nà jié xié dào què shī de gèngshēn , chēlún cóng yuànlǐ dài chū jǐtiáo hēi yìn .
pairs.english: The afternoon alley had just been sprinkled with water, but that stretch of slope at the firm's back door was wetter still; wheels carried a few black marks out from the courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 午后的巷子刚洒过水，货行后门那截斜道却湿得更深，车轮从院里带出几条黑印。

pairs.target: tāmen dào shí , yíliàng zài zhe bùbāo de liǎnglún huòchē tíng zài xié dào shàng , chēyuán gēzhe , méiyǒu tào shēngkǒu , liǎnggè rén zhèng wǎnghòu nuó ménbiān de mùjià .
pairs.english: When they arrived, a two-wheeled freight cart loaded with cloth bundles stood on the slope, its shafts at rest, with no draft animal harnessed; two people were moving the wooden rack by the door backward.
pairs.hanzi: 他们到时，一辆载着布包的两轮货车停在斜道上，车辕搁着，没有套牲口，两个人正往后挪门边的木架。

pairs.target: tuīchē de lǎohàn zài yuànlǐ , rènchū tǎ wéi biàn táishǒu , jiào tāmen xiān kào ménzhù zhàn , děng chē guòqù zài jìn .
pairs.english: The old man who pushed carts was in the courtyard; recognising Tavi, he then raised a hand and told them to stand beside the doorpost first, waiting for the cart to pass before entering.
pairs.hanzi: 推车的老汉在院里，认出塔维便抬手，叫他们先靠门柱站，等车过去再进。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng yàng zhǐ ná chūlái , fēng cóng yuànlǐ guànchū , zhǐ jiǎo pāi zài shǒushàng , tā dītóu qù yā , zhèng tīngjiàn mùtou lièkāi de duǎn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi took the sample sheet out; wind rushed from the courtyard and a paper corner slapped his hand; he lowered his head to press it down, just as he heard the brief crack of splitting wood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将样纸拿出来，风从院里灌出，纸角拍在手上，他低头去压，正听见木头裂开的短响。

pairs.target: nà búshì yǒurén luòxià mùliào , shēngyīn tiēzhe dì , tā táitóu shí , chēlún páng yā zhe de mùxiē yǐjīng wāi dào yìbiān .
pairs.english: That was not someone dropping timber; the sound was close to the ground, and when he looked up, the wooden chock pressed beside the wheel was already askew to one side.
pairs.hanzi: 那不是有人落下木料，声音贴着地，他抬头时，车轮旁压着的木楔已经歪到一边。

pairs.target: chēshēn huǎnhuǎn wǎnghòu zuò , bùbāo xiān jǐ le yíxià , gēnzhe lúnzi yì zhuǎn , xié dào shàng nà dào hēi yìn hūrán cháng le .
pairs.english: The cart settled slowly backward; the cloth bundles first shifted against each other once, then the wheel turned and that black mark on the slope suddenly grew longer.
pairs.hanzi: 车身缓缓往后坐，布包先挤了一下，跟着轮子一转，斜道上那道黑印忽然长了。

pairs.target: yīwén hǎn tā de míngzì , zuàn zhù hòu lǐng bǎ tā chě xiàng ménwài , tǎ wéi de jiǎo hái xiǎng wǎng yuánxiān zhàn de dìfāng luò , zuǒ xī xiān kē shàng shí yán .
pairs.english: Iven called his name, seized the back of his collar and dragged him out through the doorway; Tavi's foot still tried to land in the place where he had been standing previously, but his left knee struck the stone edge first.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文喊他的名字，攥住后领把他扯向门外，塔维的脚还想往原先站的地方落，左膝先磕上石沿。

pairs.target: tā méi láidejí hǎn , yīlǐng bèi lā dé lèzhù hóulóng , chē cè cóng ménzhù páng cā guò , mùtou hé shítou mó chū yìshēng cū xiǎng .
pairs.english: He had no time to shout; his collar was pulled tight and constricted his throat, the cart's side scraped past the doorpost, and wood and stone ground out a harsh noise.
pairs.hanzi: 他没来得及喊，衣领被拉得勒住喉咙，车侧从门柱旁擦过，木头和石头磨出一声粗响。

pairs.target: yígè gāngtái kāi mùjià de rén duǒ xiàng qiángbiān , láibùjí shōuhuí de yòu qiánbì bèi chē cè dǐng le yíxià , tā bào zhe shǒubì zuò dào dìshàng .
pairs.english: A man who had just lifted aside the wooden rack dodged toward the wall; his right forearm, not pulled clear in time, was struck once by the cart's side, and he sat down on the ground cradling his arm.
pairs.hanzi: 一个刚抬开木架的人躲向墙边，来不及收回的右前臂被车侧顶了一下，他抱着手臂坐到地上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chēng dì xiǎng qǐlái , xī shàng xiàng yā zhe yíkuài rè shí , yuànlǐ yǒurén hǎn búyào zhàn dào lún hòutou , tā cái kànjiàn zìjǐ zhèngyào qù nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi braced against the ground to get up, his knee feeling as if a hot stone pressed on it; someone in the courtyard shouted not to stand behind the wheel, and only then did he see where he himself was about to go.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维撑地想起来，膝上像压着一块热石，院里有人喊不要站到轮后头，他才看见自己正要去哪里。

pairs.target: lǎohàn yǐjīng jiāng yìgēn mùgàng shēn dào lún cè , lìng yígè rén yāzhù chēyuán , jiào ménwài de rén dōu sànkāi , bié zài zhǎi kǒu dǔ zhe .
pairs.english: The old man had already extended a wooden lever beside the wheel; another person held down the shafts and called for everyone outside to disperse, not to block the narrow opening.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉已经将一根木杠伸到轮侧，另一个人压住车辕，叫门外的人都散开，别在窄口堵着。

pairs.target: " hòu xiē !
pairs.english: “Thick chocks!
pairs.hanzi: “厚楔！

pairs.target: mén lǐ kàozuǒ ! "
pairs.english: Inside the door, on the left!”
pairs.hanzi: 门里靠左！”

pairs.target: zhè yícì lǎohàn cháo tā hǎn , tǎ wéi shùnzhe tā zhǐ de fāngxiàng kànjiàn qiánggēn nà jǐkuài shēnsè mùtou , shēnshǒu qǔ le zuì shàngtóu de yíkuài .
pairs.english: This time the old man shouted toward him; following the direction he pointed, Tavi saw those few blocks of dark wood at the wall's base and reached to take the topmost one.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次老汉朝他喊，塔维顺着他指的方向看见墙根那几块深色木头，伸手取了最上头的一块。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu qù pèng gǔn zhe de lúnzi , jiāng mùxiē cóng kòng chù dìgěi yuànlǐ de rén , nà rén děng lǎohàn qiàokāi yìdiǎn , lìkè cóng cèmiàn sāi le jìnqù .
pairs.english: He did not touch the wheel as it rolled; he passed the wooden chock through the gap to a person in the courtyard, who waited for the old man to lever up a little and immediately inserted it from the side.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有去碰滚着的轮子，将木楔从空处递给院里的人，那人等老汉撬开一点，立刻从侧面塞了进去。

alignment.english: to a person in the courtyard

pairs.target: chēshēn yòu chén le yíxià , tíngzhù le , jǐgè rén hái yā zhe , lǎohàn jiào zài sāi yíkuài , méi ràng shuí yīnwèi tíng le jiù xiān chè shǒu .
pairs.english: The cart sank once more and stopped; several people still held it down, and the old man called for another block to be inserted, not letting anyone remove their hands first just because it had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 车身又沉了一下，停住了，几个人还压着，老汉叫再塞一块，没让谁因为停了就先撤手。

pairs.target: yīwén dūn zài tā pángbiān , yòushǒu hái zuàn zhe nà jié yīlǐng , tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ chuǎn búguò qì , tā cái sōngkāi , zhǐjié shàng cèng le yìcéng huī .
pairs.english: Iven crouched beside him, his right hand still gripping that bit of collar; Tavi said he himself could not breathe, and only then did he let go, his knuckles smeared with a layer of dust.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蹲在他旁边，右手还攥着那截衣领，塔维说自己喘不过气，他才松开，指节上蹭了一层灰。

pairs.target: nà zhāng yàng zhǐ luò zài xié dào biān , shī shuǐ cóng zì dǐxià màn guòqù , tōng bùliǎo chē jǐzì réng néng rèn , tā què méiyǒu guòqù jiǎn .
pairs.english: That sample sheet lay beside the slope, water spreading beneath the writing; the words no carts could cross were still legible, but he did not go to pick it up.
pairs.hanzi: 那张样纸落在斜道边，湿水从字底下漫过去，通不了车几字仍能认，他却没有过去捡。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ de rén jiāng shòushāng de nánrén fú kāi , nà rén jiào biépèng shǒuwàn , yòu wèn chē tíng méi tíng , méi rén dá tā gēbo shìbushì duàn le .
pairs.english: People in the courtyard helped the injured man aside; he told them not to touch his wrist, then asked if the cart had stopped; nobody answered whether his arm was broken.
pairs.hanzi: 院里的人将受伤的男人扶开，那人叫别碰手腕，又问车停没停，没人答他胳膊是不是断了。

pairs.target: huò háng de rén cóngqián tou pǎo lái , dìyījù wèn shuí bǎ chē fàngzài zhèlǐ , lǎohàn jiāng duàn xiē rēng dào tā jiǎo biān , shuō xiān qù zhǎo yīzhě .
pairs.english: The firm's man ran from the front, his first question asking who had left the cart here; the old man threw the broken chock at his feet and said to find a healer first.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人从前头跑来，第一句问谁把车放在这里，老汉将断楔扔到他脚边，说先去找医者。

pairs.target: tāliǎ háiyào zhēng , zuò zhe de rén yòu xī le yìkǒuqì , huò háng de rén zhè cái jiào yígè niánqīngrén qù , zìjǐ ràng pángrén bǎ bùbāo xièxià yìcéng .
pairs.english: Those two were still about to argue; the seated man drew another breath, and only then did the firm's man send a young person off, himself getting others to unload one layer of cloth bundles.
pairs.hanzi: 他俩还要争，坐着的人又吸了一口气，货行的人这才叫一个年轻人去，自己让旁人把布包卸下一层。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn xīgài , kùzǐ méi pò , bù dǐxià què yǐjīng gǔqǐ yìdiǎn , tā shēnshǒu qù àn , yīwén yòng yòushǒu bèi dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi lowered his head to look at his knee; his trousers were not torn, but a slight swelling had already risen beneath the cloth; he reached to press it, and Iven blocked him with the back of his right hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看膝盖，裤子没破，布底下却已经鼓起一点，他伸手去按，伊文用右手背挡住。

alignment.english: the back of his right hand

pairs.target: " xiān biéshì néng bunéng zǒu . "
pairs.english: “Don't try whether you can walk yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “先别试能不能走。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō de hěnkuài , zìjǐ zhàn qǐ shí què fú le yíxià mén , zuǒshǒu bèi de pí yǐjīng cāpò , liǎng rén shuí yě méi shuō zhǐshì yíxià .
pairs.english: Iven spoke very fast, yet steadied himself briefly on the door as he stood, the skin on his left hand's back already scraped; neither of them said it was only a little knock.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说得很快，自己站起时却扶了一下门，左手背的皮已经擦破，两人谁也没说只是一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàozhe qiáng , tīngjiàn mùgàng chóngxīn luò huí dìshàng , shēnzi yòu wǎng lǐ suō , xiǎngqǐ shàng huí lín kē jiào tā kàn jiǎoxià , jiǎoxià què búshì zǎo sǎo hǎo de shā .
pairs.english: Tavi leaned against the wall, heard the wooden lever fall back to the ground, and shrank inward again; he remembered Lin Ke telling him last time to watch his feet, but beneath his feet was not sand swept in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维靠着墙，听见木杠重新落回地上，身子又往里缩，想起上回林珂叫他看脚下，脚下却不是早扫好的沙。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu nǎ yíduì rèn guò de tiě , yě méiyǒu shuāngshǒu tiē wěn de gōngfū , fāngcái shēnchū qù chēng dì de nà zhī shǒu , zhǐjiān zhídàoxiànzài hái zài dǒu .
pairs.english: He had no familiar pair of iron pieces, nor time to set both hands firmly in contact; the fingertips of that hand he had just stretched out to brace against the ground were still trembling even now.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有哪一对认过的铁，也没有双手贴稳的工夫，方才伸出去撑地的那只手，指尖直到现在还在抖。

pairs.target: lǎohàn jiǎnqǐ yàng zhǐ , méi pāidiào shuǐ , jiāng tā dì dào tā xī páng , shuō jīnrì xiān bié wèn zhège , qù qiántou zuò , lùkǒu liúgěi yīzhě jìn .
pairs.english: The old man picked up the sample sheet without shaking off the water, handed it beside his knee, and said not to ask about this today yet: go sit at the front and leave the entrance for the healer to come through.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉捡起样纸，没拍掉水，将它递到他膝旁，说今日先别问这个，去前头坐，路口留给医者进。

pairs.target: yīwén ná guò cèzi , tǎ wéi fú zhe qiáng mànmàn qǐshēn , zuǒtuǐ yì chéngzhòng biàn téng , tā méiyǒu bǎ nà yíxià cáng jìn xià yíbù lǐ .
pairs.english: Iven took the notebook; Tavi slowly got up supporting himself on the wall, his left leg hurting as soon as it bore weight; he did not hide that jolt of pain in the next step.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文拿过册子，塔维扶着墙慢慢起身，左腿一承重便疼，他没有把那一下藏进下一步里。

alignment.english: as soon as it bore weight

pairs.target: liǎng rén zhǐ nuó dào ménnèi zuìjìn de chángdèng , shēnhòu yǒurén yòu wèn shuí fàng de chē , zhè yìhuí tǎ wéi tīng qīng le , què hái bùnéng tì shuí huídá .
pairs.english: The two only moved to the nearest bench inside the door; behind them someone again asked who had left the cart, and this time Tavi heard clearly, yet still could not answer for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 两人只挪到门内最近的长凳，身后有人又问谁放的车，这一回塔维听清了，却还不能替谁回答。
